summary.en: Global AI leader providing multimodal models including large language, computer vision and generative AI models.
summary.zh: 全球AI领军企业，提供多模态模型，包括大语言模型、计算机视觉和生成式AI模型。

title.en: SenseTime SenseNova API Key - Multimodal AI Models | Get Model Key
title.zh: 商汤科技SenseNova API Key - 多模态AI模型 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get SenseTime SenseNova API key for access to multimodal AI models.
description.zh: 获取商汤科技SenseNova API Key，访问多模态AI模型。

en: SenseTime SenseNova is the multimodal AI platform from SenseTime, covering large language, computer vision, and generative AI capabilities for enterprise and developer use in China and beyond.
API access is managed through platform.sensetime.com, with documentation for integrating SenseNova models into applications.
getModelKey links the official SenseTime platform console only. We do not sell SenseNova API keys.
zh: 商汤科技 SenseNova 是商汤的多模态 AI 平台，覆盖大语言、计算机视觉与生成式 AI，面向企业与开发者。
API 在 platform.sensetime.com 管理，文档说明如何将 SenseNova 模型接入应用。
getModelKey 只链到商汤官方平台控制台，不出售 SenseNova API Key。

en: Go to https://platform.sensetime.com/console/api (or the platform login) and register or sign in.
Complete any required enterprise or real-name steps the console requests.
Create an API key or credential in the SenseNova console and store it securely.
Call SenseNova APIs per platform.sensetime.com/docs and revoke keys there when needed.
zh: 打开 https://platform.sensetime.com/console/api （或平台登录页）注册/登录。
按控制台要求完成企业认证或实名等步骤。
在 SenseNova 控制台创建 API Key/凭证并安全保存。
按 platform.sensetime.com/docs 调用接口，需要时在同一控制台吊销。

answer.en: SenseTime positions LLM, CV, and generative AI under SenseNova. See the live catalog on the official platform.
answer.zh: 商汤将大语言、视觉与生成式 AI 等能力归于 SenseNova；以官方平台当前目录为准。

answer.en: SenseTime’s SenseNova platform is widely used in China enterprise scenarios; account rules follow official SenseTime policy.
answer.zh: SenseNova 在国内企业场景使用广泛，开户与合规要求以商汤官方政策为准。

question.en: Can I purchase a SenseNova key here?
question.zh: 能在这里购买 SenseNova Key 吗？

answer.en: No. getModelKey only links platform.sensetime.com for self-service official access.
answer.zh: 不能。getModelKey 只链到 platform.sensetime.com，请自行在官方开通。
